name: Soybean Crush Spread — GPM Analysis
description: Research study analyzing the CBOT soybean crush spread (Gross Processing Margin). Uses ZS (soybeans), ZL (soybean oil), and ZM (soybean meal) futures with NoAdjustment continuation. Calculates GPM ($/bu) using CBOT conversion factors: oil yield 11 lbs/bu, meal yield 47.5 lbs/bu ($/short ton). Outputs: (1) Summary table with current GPM, oil/meal revenue, and revenue shares, (2) GPM over time with 20-day MA and seasonal norm, (3) Oil vs Meal revenue comparison chart.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SOYBEAN CRUSH SPREAD — GROSS PROCESSING MARGIN (GPM)
# =============================================================================
#
# Conversion factors (CBOT standard, per bushel of soybeans):
#   Oil:  11 lbs/bu yield, ZL quoted in cents/lb
#   Meal: 47.5 lbs/bu yield, ZM quoted in $/short ton (2000 lbs)
#   ZS:   quoted in cents/bushel
#
# Unit conversions to $/bushel:
#   Oil revenue  = 11 × (ZL / 100)
#   Meal revenue = (47.5 / 2000) × ZM = 0.02375 × ZM
#   Soybean cost = ZS / 100
#   GPM          = Oil revenue + Meal revenue − Soybean cost
#
# NoAdjustment used for all three — preserves real price levels for
# cross-commodity spread analysis.
# =============================================================================

# --- Load ZS (Soybeans) via reference_futures + continuation ---
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zs_ref.o, zs_ref.h, zs_ref.l, zs_ref.c, zs_ref.v, zs_ref.oi, zs_ref.s)

# --- Load ZL (Soybean Oil) via reference_futures + continuation ---
zl_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_ref.o, zl_ref.h, zl_ref.l, zl_ref.c, zl_ref.v, zl_ref.oi, zl_ref.s)

# --- Load ZM (Soybean Meal) via reference_futures + continuation ---
zm_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_ref.o, zm_ref.h, zm_ref.l, zm_ref.c, zm_ref.v, zm_ref.oi, zm_ref.s)

# --- Crush Spread Calculation (all in $/bushel) ---
# Oil revenue: 11 lbs/bu × (ZL cents/lb ÷ 100) = $/bu
oil_revenue = 11.0 * (zl_cont.c / 100.0)

# Meal revenue: (47.5 lbs/bu ÷ 2000 lbs/ton) × ZM $/ton = $/bu
meal_revenue = 0.02375 * zm_cont.c

# Soybean cost: ZS cents/bu ÷ 100 = $/bu
soybean_cost = zs_cont.c / 100.0

# Gross Processing Margin
gpm = oil_revenue + meal_revenue - soybean_cost

# GPM 20-day moving average
gpm_ma20 = ma(period=20)(gpm)

# --- Revenue Shares ---
total_revenue = oil_revenue + meal_revenue
oil_share = oil_revenue / total_revenue
meal_share = meal_revenue / total_revenue

# --- Seasonal Norm: expanding mean of GPM per calendar month, ffilled ---
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

is_jan = month_num == 1
is_feb = month_num == 2
is_mar = month_num == 3
is_apr = month_num == 4
is_may = month_num == 5
is_jun = month_num == 6
is_jul = month_num == 7
is_aug = month_num == 8
is_sep = month_num == 9
is_oct = month_num == 10
is_nov = month_num == 11
is_dec = month_num == 12

jan_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jan, gpm)))
feb_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_feb, gpm)))
mar_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_mar, gpm)))
apr_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_apr, gpm)))
may_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_may, gpm)))
jun_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jun, gpm)))
jul_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jul, gpm)))
aug_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_aug, gpm)))
sep_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_sep, gpm)))
oct_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_oct, gpm)))
nov_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_nov, gpm)))
dec_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_dec, gpm)))

seasonal_norm = conditional_select(
    is_jan, jan_avg,
    is_feb, feb_avg,
    is_mar, mar_avg,
    is_apr, apr_avg,
    is_may, may_avg,
    is_jun, jun_avg,
    is_jul, jul_avg,
    is_aug, aug_avg,
    is_sep, sep_avg,
    is_oct, oct_avg,
    is_nov, nov_avg,
    dec_avg
)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — Current Crush Metrics
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Soybean Crush Spread Snapshot',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Margin', 'Revenue Split'],
        col_headers=['GPM ($/bu)', 'Oil Rev ($/bu)', 'Meal Rev ($/bu)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(info='Current GPM', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Current Oil Revenue', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Current Meal Revenue', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Oil Share of Revenue', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='Meal Share of Revenue', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='Seasonal Norm GPM', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Snapshot',
    order=0
)(gpm, oil_revenue, meal_revenue, oil_share, meal_share, seasonal_norm)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: GPM Over Time with 20d MA & Seasonal Norm
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Gross Processing Margin — Soybean Crush',
    category='2. GPM Analysis',
    y_axis_label='GPM ($/bu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='GPM', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Seasonal Norm', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(gpm, gpm_ma20, seasonal_norm))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Oil vs Meal Revenue Split Over Time
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Oil vs Meal Revenue per Bushel Crushed',
    category='3. Revenue Split',
    y_axis_label='Revenue ($/bu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Oil Revenue', color=Color.Amber),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Meal Revenue', color=Color.Teal)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(oil_revenue, meal_revenue))
